m_csa:750 must fail any FMO positive gate. If FAD semiquinone plus Fe-S radical dehydration evidence is present, reject as OOS/future radical-flavin-Fe-S dehydratase rather than route to FMO or ordinary flavin reductase.

m_csa:123 and APS-reductase-like covalent FAD-adduct rows must not route to FMO. Route to flavin_dehydrogenase_reductase with boundary metadata or abstain in child-label settings unless a dedicated covalent-FAD-adduct stratum exists.
Heme ligation, P450/peroxidase/heme oxygenase mechanism evidence, or compound-I-like oxygen activation must route away from FMO even when the row is an oxygenase or monooxygenase.

Non-flavin oxygenases, dioxygenases, luciferase oxygenations, pterin/non-heme iron hydroxylases, copper monooxygenases, and soluble methane monooxygenase-like metal systems must reject as FMO unless flavin C4a-peroxy evidence is directly present.

positive_fmo_axis_not_negative_controls.axis_definition: Clean FMO requires flavin-dependent O2 activation to a C4a-(hydro)peroxyflavin or equivalent flavin peroxy oxygenating intermediate, followed by substrate oxygen insertion/oxygenation.
positive_fmo_axis_not_negative_controls.policy_note: m_csa:551 and m_csa:973 are not hard negatives; the acquisition closure treats them as clean FMO secondary/future rows while blocking primary promotion until n>=6 and hard-negative separation are satisfied.

control_groups.recommended_regression_gate: An FMO route is a regression for this group unless mechanism evidence explicitly shows flavin-dependent O2 activation to a C4a-(hydro)peroxyflavin and substrate oxygen insertion. Otherwise route to flavin_dehydrogenase_reductase.
Rows with O2 as terminal acceptor, peroxide detoxification, or oxidase naming must not pass the FMO gate without explicit C4a-peroxy oxygen-transfer evidence.

For Fe-S plus flavin rows, require explicit flavin peroxy oxygenating chemistry before any FMO route. If Fe-S is an electron relay and the flavin role is substrate reduction or electron transfer, route to flavin_dehydrogenase_reductase with cofactor_complexity diagnostics.
m_csa:497 must fail any FMO positive gate. A non-abstaining FMO call on this row is a hard regression; preferred behavior is reject as OOS until a dedicated flavodiiron NO reductase family exists.

m_csa:750 must fail any FMO positive gate. If FAD semiquinone plus Fe-S radical dehydration evidence is present, reject as OOS/future radical-flavin-Fe-S dehydratase rather than route to FMO or ordinary flavin reductase.

m_csa:123 and APS-reductase-like covalent FAD-adduct rows must not route to FMO. Route to flavin_dehydrogenase_reductase with boundary metadata or abstain in child-label settings unless a dedicated covalent-FAD-adduct stratum exists.
Heme ligation, P450/peroxidase/heme oxygenase mechanism evidence, or compound-I-like oxygen activation must route away from FMO even when the row is an oxygenase or monooxygenase.

Non-flavin oxygenases, dioxygenases, luciferase oxygenations, pterin/non-heme iron hydroxylases, copper monooxygenases, and soluble methane monooxygenase-like metal systems must reject as FMO unless flavin C4a-peroxy evidence is directly present.

recommended_global_regression_gates: Do not treat FAD/FMN, NAD(P)H, O2, Fe-S, or oxygenase naming as sufficient for FMO.
Require explicit flavin-dependent O2 activation to a C4a-(hydro)peroxyflavin or equivalent flavin peroxy oxygenating intermediate plus substrate oxygen insertion for FMO.
Route ordinary flavin hydride-transfer, flavin oxidase, and Fe-S relay rows to flavin_dehydrogenase_reductase, carrying cofactor_complexity and mechanism_class diagnostics where available.
Reject current OOS relabel controls m_csa:497 and m_csa:750 for FMO; do not count them in primary flavin metrics.
